title: Two Names in One Slot
story: The clinic calendar showed two patients in the same slot, so Leila checked the booking tool before calling either of them. One appointment had been moved online, but the change had never reached the wall screen. She updated the display and added a note asking staff to refresh it after every edit. The second patient was offered a later time and accepted.

vocabulary.definition: A plan that shows days and booked times.
A particular time kept for an appointment.
An arrangement to see someone at a set time.

quiz.question: What did Leila check before calling the patients?
options: The booking tool
A later time for both of them
The lock on the clinic door
An online shop for screens
quiz.explanation: She checked the booking tool before calling either patient.
quiz.supportingSentence: The clinic calendar showed two patients in the same slot, so Leila checked the booking tool before calling either of them.

quiz.question: Why did the wall screen still show a clash?
options: A change in the booking tool had not been copied onto it
Both patients had walked in at the same moment
Leila had offered them one later time already
The staff had refreshed it after every edit
quiz.correctAnswer: A change in the booking tool had not been copied onto it
quiz.explanation: One appointment had been moved, but that change had never reached the wall screen.
quiz.supportingSentence: One appointment had been moved online, but the change had never reached the wall screen.

quiz.question: What did the second patient’s answer do to the clash?
options: It removed the clash by moving that patient
It left both patients in the same slot
It forced the wall screen to stay wrong
It cancelled the online appointment
quiz.correctAnswer: It removed the clash by moving that patient
quiz.explanation: The second patient accepted a later time, so that person was no longer in the shared slot.
quiz.supportingSentence: The second patient was offered a later time and accepted.

quiz.question: What does slot mean in this story?
options: A booked time space
The clinic’s wall screen
A note left for the staff
A patient who arrives late
quiz.explanation: Two patients appear in the same slot, meaning the same appointment time.
quiz.supportingSentence: The clinic calendar showed two patients in the same slot, so Leila checked the booking tool before calling either of them.

quiz.question: Why did Leila ask staff to refresh the display after edits?
options: So the wall screen would show the latest bookings
So patients would be called before any check
So every visit would move online
So the second patient would refuse a new time
quiz.correctAnswer: So the wall screen would show the latest bookings
quiz.explanation: Refreshing after every edit would stop the display from missing a change again.
quiz.supportingSentence: She updated the display and added a note asking staff to refresh it after every edit.
